digestNormalization.rationale: Excludes the self-referential digest and the plan revision bound by the canonical decision at adoption.
digestNormalization.stalenessRule: Only the latest non-superseded adoption digest for this path is valid; any other digest is REJECT-STALE.

adoptionSource: PENDING: authored by kbd-spec on 2026-10-26 and not adopted. Adoption requires an explicit operator instruction naming this file.
decisionOwner: Operator (Travis James): topology, toolchain, model choice, versions.toml pins, tier gate, scope amendments. uar-agent-expert for UAR-side work through a lead-scoped handoff.
amendmentPolicy: Content changes are adopted with --supersedes <prior decision id> through kbd-contract-adopt.sh. desktop-uar-topology option tasks arrive by such an amendment after decision 3.

releaseClaim.userOperation: On a fresh install, a practice user opens PatientGPT on macOS desktop, iOS or Android, prepares the on-device assistant with visible progress, and the local model holds an onboarding conversation whose user-confirmed proposals download models and record a UAR endpoint, while UAR is absent. Separately, the UAR path is shown on the cloud host by URL, embedded on iOS, and on desktop through the chosen topology.
supportedEnvironments: iOS app on 'My Mac (Designed for iPad)'
iOS simulator (embedding, store and refusal only)
arm64 Android emulator API 36 with at least 4 GiB (on the ARM MacBook Pro)
Axum cloud host on localhost with a local UAR v1.3.0 service
releaseClaim.currentCapabilities: None of this exists today: no inference, embedder, model storage or real UAR in PatientGPT (assessment.md). Spec has written 12 changes; implementation is 0 of 0 tracked.
explicitUnknowns: Whether MLX-Swift produces a reply on the Mac destination and on an iPhone (no prior evidence anywhere)
Whether LiteRT-LM CPU runs on an arm64 emulator
Whether UAR v1.3.0 builds on stable Rust and how its patch overlay affects PatientGPT's surrealdb 3.3.0
iOS binary size added by UAR, fastembed/ort and RocksDB
Qwen3-0.6B's rate of valid setup proposals
Whether a physical iPhone and an Apple signing team are available
Evidence host: chat, Mac-destination, simulator-embedding and arm64-emulator scenarios need the operator's Apple Silicon MacBook Pro (D-018); this Intel Mac cannot run them
Which model provider the local UAR service uses for UAR-1
How a PatientGPT agent is installed on a UAR v1.3.0 service

functionalScope: Explicit per-turn lanes (local, uar), the onboarding scope gate and the none UAR mode
Pinned model catalog with verified, resumable acquisition and RAM preflight
Local chat on macOS (mlex), iOS device and Mac destination (MLX-Swift), Android (LiteRT-LM CPU)
Local embedder (fastembed + arctic-embed-xs int8) on every native target
SurrealDB mobile store for conversations and settings, with ADR
AG-UI 1.0 to subset bridge, UAR service client and scope-to-agent routing
Embedded UAR on iOS with an onboarding-only local driver and deny-by-default tool admission
Desktop UAR topology chosen after the spike
Local-model onboarding with host-validated, user-confirmed proposals and setup commands

resilienceScope.policy: Adopted resilience requirements (integrity rejection, resume, engine and UAR failure containment, store-open failure, UAR unavailability) are acceptance scenarios and never defer through budget overflow.
deferredOptional: Automatic retry of UAR service runs

exclusions: Agentic clinical work on the local model (goal 5)
Connecting to the recorded UAR endpoint
Persisting PatientGPT embedding vectors and local semantic search
Clinical UAR agents and any cloud driver for them
Distribution bundles beyond operator-approved evidence runs
requiredSafetyChecks: No PHI or real patient data in fixtures, logs, prompts or commits; synthetic data only
Embeddings and all local-lane content classified local and never sent to a network endpoint
Every model file verified by pinned size and SHA-256 before load
Lane parsed with no default; unknown or missing lane rejected
Local lane refused outside the onboarding scope
Local driver drives only the onboarding agent; deny-by-default tool admission; clinical commands never grantable to agents
Setup steps executed only from host-stored proposals after user confirmation
UAR token read from the environment, never logged or returned to shells
versions.toml edited only by the operator

budgets.tokenFallback: Checkpoint and report at every change boundary; stop on the no-progress limit
budgets.exhaustion: Checkpoint, record BLOCKED with the reason, and ask the operator; never extend silently

evidenceInvalidation: A scenario's evidence is invalidated by a change to the PatientGPT source its owner change touches (git revision recorded per receipt), a catalog digest change, a UAR pin change for UAR scenarios, or a plan revision that amends its change. Only affected scenarios are rerun; earlier receipts stay in their dated folder.

workerRoutes.agent: Claude Code root agent with patientgpt-delivery native roles (rust-domain-engineer, tauri-engineer, flutter-engineer, react-engineer, storage-engineer, uar-agent-expert, flint-data-engineer, identity-security-engineer, design-expert, creative-director, documentation-engineer, platform-release-engineer; product-manager and team-lead for scope and integration)
workerRoutes.model: Session model at authoring: claude-opus-5-5; role models per .agent-team/patientgpt-delivery/team.json
workerRoutes.subagents: Disjoint file ownership per change; one Cargo build at a time; critics dormant until the phase boundary

expectedEffects: Scratch data directories, a dedicated simulator and AVD state, model downloads from huggingface.co, a local UAR service on a free port
Receipts in a new dated evidence folder; no change to real app data roots
boundaryPacket.requiredApprovals: Operator, once at the boundary: switch to the Apple Silicon MacBook Pro (D-018), tier gate for optimized evidence builds (PROMETHEUS_TIER3=1), device and signing availability, UAR provider and PAT, decision 3 recorded
cleanup: Delete scratch data directories and the dedicated simulator
Stop the local UAR service and revoke its PAT
Uninstall evidence app builds from devices
stopConditions: A missing prerequisite (record BLOCKED and stop that batch)
